# BC version prefixes to test against.
# Both test-matrix.yml and publish.yml read this file.
# Add or remove versions here — both workflows pick up changes automatically.
#
# BC 26 is deliberately absent. The canonical corpus (tests/al-language) declares
# platform 27.0.0.0 and requires System Application / Base Application >= 27.5.0.0
# in its own app.json, so no BC 26 provisioning can satisfy it and the leg cannot
# go green regardless of runner capability. The corpus is a read-only upstream
# submodule, so that floor is not ours to lower. See docs/limitations.md.
27.0 27.3 27.5 28.0 28.1
